item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】ALAC - Destiny's Child - #1's [Apple Lossless 24bit / 44.1kHz]
item.description:
N O T E
With Apple Music exclusives becoming more and more popular and 24bit becoming the new norm, it is unsure if labels are sending out true 24bit files for older albums or if they're upscaling them since 44.1khz means Spek and other programs can read 44.1khz that'll look like a lossless 16-bit and it has no way to show if it's more than that without changing the sample rate (which then leaves blank space). As this was made in a time of the world where vinyls were not as popular... more than likely, it's possible this is just another "24bit upscale" from the label. With that being said, I am posting since this in case it's real - these were ripped by me. 24bit is not even recognizable to the human ear, but if you'd like to have this for your downloads, this is for you.
I am not responsible if this is a 24-bit upscale provided by the distributors of the files (whoever sends them out via the label), but regardless, I still hope you enjoy.
